messages:
Emilia (CEO): Quick thread to collect follow-ups from today's all-hands on reliability. RCA here: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2026-03-ingress-throttle. Post any questions or confirm action ownership in-thread.

Sam (VP Eng): Summary for folks who missed it: ~35m service degradation due to an autoscaler policy flip + cache TTL override after a model rollout. Primary mitigation: manual scale + config rollback.

Rohit (SRE Lead): RCA draft updated with timeline + initial mitigation notes. Still missing one cache server log; attaching soon. Added alert rule infra:cache-ttl-drift.

Priya (Runtime eng): Confirmed rollback of quantized flag across regions. PR: rollback-config-pr-501 merged at 2026-03-26T02:05Z. Will file follow-up to make flag gated behind feature-flag.

Jess (Customer Ops): I'll prepare a plain-language customer note and a spreadsheet of impacted accounts with severity. Draft to be posted by EOD tomorrow: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/cs/ingress-impact-list. Who should approve final text? Legal + Sam?

Tara (Product): Product will own severity mapping and a small roadmap item: "deploy safety checklist" for model config changes. ETA to add to backlog: this sprint.

Lina (Docs): Creating a 1-page postmortem summary for onboarding and a short "do/don't" checklist for engineers. Will put in handbook and link here.

diego (oncall): Canary started with enhanced tail-latency traces: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingress/canary. First 6h look stable. I'll post 24h and 48h snapshots.

ops-bot (deploy-bot): Deploy: rollback-config-pr-501 merged by @Priya at 2026-03-26T02:05Z.

Rohit (SRE Lead): Action items I own: 1) attach missing cache log + finalize RCA by 2026-03-28 2) create alert infra:cache-ttl-drift and verify on staging by 2026-03-27 3) schedule blameless review meeting.

Priya (Runtime eng): My action items: 1) gate quantized config behind feature-flag + CI check by 2026-04-02 2) add a preflight check to the deploy bot to prevent unreviewed pushes to dedicated pools.

Jess (Customer Ops): My action items: 1) customer comms draft by 2026-03-27 EOD 2) share impacted-account spreadsheet with Finance and Support.

Marta (Finance): I'll review the impacted list and estimate whether SLA credits are required; will respond within 48h after Jess posts the list.

Sam (VP Eng): Additional ask: engineers, please avoid direct edits in /etc/redwood/models/flags.yml on prod. Use the config service and follow change review. We'll add a gating checklist to deploy-bot.

Emilia (CEO): Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your action items so we can close them. We'll reconvene in the follow-up retro next week. Thanks for the quick coordination. :clap:
